title: The Mediterranean diet is the best out there. Here’s why Americans struggle with it.
summary: The Mediterranean diet is recognized as the healthiest eating pattern, yet many Americans struggle to adopt it. The challenge extends beyond dietary choices to lifestyle factors, including cooking at home and sharing meals with family and friends, which are central to the Mediterranean approach.
content: It’s not just about eating well. It’s about cooking at home and sharing those meals with friends and family.

zh.title: 地中海饮食是最好的。以下是美国人难以坚持它的原因。
zh.summary: 地中海饮食被认为是最健康的饮食方式，但许多美国人难以采纳它。这个挑战超越了饮食选择，延伸到生活方式因素，包括在家做饭和与家人朋友一起用餐，这些是地中海饮食方法的核心。

title: Top Wall Street analysts like these 3 dividend stocks for steady income
summary: Top Wall Street analysts are recommending dividend-paying energy stocks as reliable income sources for investors. These stocks offer steady returns suited for portfolios seeking consistent income generation.
content: Investors looking for steady income can add dividend-paying energy stocks to their portfolios.

zh.title: 华尔街顶级分析师看好这3只分红股票作为稳定收入来源
zh.summary: 华尔街顶级分析师推荐分红能源股作为投资者可靠的收入来源。这些股票提供适合寻求稳定收入生成的投资组合的稳定回报。

title: Goldman Sachs picks China stocks poised to benefit from a new wave of AI-related hardware exports
summary: Goldman Sachs has identified Chinese stocks positioned to capitalize on growing AI-related hardware exports. The firm emphasizes that successful corporate strategy execution will be more critical than macroeconomic conditions for these stocks' performance.
content: The Wall Street powerhouse notes areas where execution of corporate strategy matters more than macroeconomic trends.

zh.title: 高盛看好中国股票有望从新一轮人工智能相关硬件出口中受益
zh.summary: 高盛已确定中国股票有望从不断增长的人工智能相关硬件出口中获益。该公司强调，成功的企业战略执行对这些股票的表现将比宏观经济条件更为关键。

title: JPMorgan could soon be the first $1 trillion bank. Top analyst Mayo says next stop is $2 trillion
summary: JPMorgan Chase is poised to become the first U.S. bank to reach a $1 trillion market value, with analyst Mayo suggesting $2 trillion could be the next milestone. Several positive market factors are supporting the bank's rising share price.
content: JPMorgan Chase could soon boast a market value in excess of $1 trillion. Several tailwinds are driving share value, according to Wells Fargo.

zh.title: 摩根大通将成为首家1万亿美元银行。顶级分析师Mayo表示下一个目标是2万亿
zh.summary: 摩根大通有望成为首家达到1万亿美元市值的美国银行，分析师Mayo表示2万亿美元可能是下一个里程碑。多个积极的市场因素正在推动该银行股价上升。

title: Walmart and Target are about to reveal the health of the U.S. consumer
summary: Upcoming earnings reports from Walmart and Target will provide key insights into consumer health amid persistent inflation. The major retailers' performance will reveal how American shoppers are managing spending in the current economic environment.
content: Earnings reports from the two major retailers will show how shoppers are holding up in an era of persistent inflation.

zh.title: 沃尔玛和Target即将揭示美国消费者的健康状况
zh.summary: 沃尔玛和Target即将发布的财报将在持续通胀时期提供关于消费者健康状况的关键洞察。这两家零售商的表现将揭示美国购物者如何在当前经济环境中管理支出。

title: Secret outperformer: Dispelling the 'myths' about an unloved stock market
summary: European stock markets, often overlooked compared to U.S. markets, are emerging as solid performers, according to Goldman Sachs analysis. The firm is challenging common misconceptions about the risks and appeal of European equities.
content: European markets fly under the radar when compared with larger and more liquid U.S. markets, but Goldman Sachs offered to dispel some of the myths.

zh.title: 秘密赢家：揭穿关于不受欢迎股市的"神话"
zh.summary: 根据高盛分析，与美国市场相比经常被忽视的欧洲股市正在成为强劲的表现者。该公司正在挑战关于欧洲股票风险和吸引力的常见误解。

title: Hurricane Lala leaves thousands without power in Hawaii amid 'life-threatening' conditions
summary: Hurricane Lala is battering Hawaii with severe life-threatening conditions, leaving thousands without power. The National Hurricane Center warns of dangerous flooding and mudslides, with predictions of up to 25 inches of rain on the Big Island.
content: The National Hurricane Center is warning of "life-threatening flooding and mudslides" conditions and predicting up to 25 inches of rain on Hawaii's Big Island.

zh.title: 飓风拉拉致使夏威夷数千人停电 面临致命恶劣天气
zh.summary: 飓风拉拉以严重的致命条件摧残夏威夷,导致数千人停电。美国国家飓风中心警告可能发生危险的洪水和泥石流,预计大岛降雨量最高可达25英寸。

title: Parents 'watering down baby milk' over high costs
summary: Parents are resorting to diluting baby milk to cope with rising living costs, according to Moorside Baby Bank, creating health risks for infants. The practice underscores the severe financial strain families face in affording basic necessities.
content: Moorside Baby Bank say parents are turning to unsafe practices over the rising cost of essentials.

zh.title: 父母因高昂成本"稀释婴儿奶粉"
zh.summary: 根据Moorside婴儿银行的数据，父母为应对不断上升的生活成本而稀释婴儿奶粉，这对婴儿造成了健康风险。这种做法突显了家庭在负担基本生活必需品方面面临的严重经济压力。
